name: Sekaki
source:
A DogHalve with a mysterious past, Sekaki serves as the resistance army's tactician and voice of reason. His analytical mind provides a perfect counterbalance to Akatora's raw power.

He sometimes struggles with the weight of his responsibilities and his own self-doubt, but his heart is always in the right place.

Likes: Mathematics, coming up with plans, commenting on food

Dislikes: Uncertainty, his own indecisiveness, reckless behavior

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/sekaki]official description[/url]]
